# Vendored Go benchmark statistics

Copied from `golang.org/x/perf` revision `22c9c6c9d4da6248aedbc79f02ecedcd59f8f5f2` (Apache-2.0; see LICENSE).

Includes the legacy `benchstat` text formatter and its `internal/stats` and `storage/benchfmt` dependencies. Test files and the optional HTML formatter (which requires safehtml) were omitted. Import paths were rewritten to `github.com/grafana/pyroscope/macro-benchmark/internal/thirdparty/…`. No statistical algorithms were changed.
